(b) Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work. Invoices shall also include receipts or other supporting detail concerning related expenses within the billing cycle.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">This is a time-and-materials consulting agreement with no licence-usage or fee-verification audit right running against us. Searches for audit, inspection, verification, records, monitoring and on-site/premises review returned nothing binding Company, and the only access-related language (§ 1(c), p0007) requires Contractor's personnel to comply with our security and system-access policies, which operates in our favour. Section 3 handles fees purely through Contractor-supplied invoice detail rather than any Company-side records examination, and Sections 4-7 contain no inspection right. Because no audit right binds Customer, the AUDIT frequency, notice, cost-allocation and system-access limits have nothing to attach to and the position is satisfied by absence; we do not volunteer an audit right in order to qualify it, since creating one would weaken our position. No redline proposed.</rationale>
